title: One Time CRM Contacts and Inbox Blueprint

workspace.external_crm_policy: No GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM runtime is allowed for this spec.

brand.name: One Time
forbidden_bleed: BNA Academy copy in Rabbi-facing CRM

controls.radius_rule: Do not mix 8px, 16px, and 999px radii for ordinary cards/buttons. Full-pill radius is reserved for status chips.

files.finding: Normalizes first-party contact rows into CRM cards with contact type, family/school classification, lifecycle/status, owner, interest, identifiers, tags, source label, follow-up, linked records, membership/access context, mailbox context, support context, follow-up task context, class/trial/access context, timeline activity, entitlement-gated filters, pagination, provider inquiry inbox, and read-only timeline no-send flags.

Provides GET /api/bna/crm/contacts, GET /api/bna/crm/contacts/:id/timeline, PATCH /api/bna/crm/contacts/:id, provider inquiry inbox, and provider mailbox endpoints. CRM list/timeline responses include no-send and external-write false flags. PATCH supports local CRM field, note, pipeline event, and follow-up task persistence with no external send/import/payment/access write.

Operations Contacts has an API-backed One Time CRM workbench with search/filter/sort, page-sized cards, three panes, selected profile/activity/timeline, safe action locks, and Open scoped inbox routing to Rabbi inbox.
Email workspace has BNA/Rabbi inbox selector, One Time Inbox context card, selected CRM context readback, readiness gates, view rail, local draft editor, detail card, and no-send approval copy.
Registry includes CRM filter, expand, open scoped inbox, update, and email inbox selection actions, with no external CRM/write guarantees.

Registry includes CRM contact APIs, scoped One Time inbox/provider mailbox routes, public One Time routes, and cron routes. Additional route rows are required only when new implementation packets add or expose routes.

current_state_inspection.baseline_delta: The repo already contains substantial CRM DTO, API, workbench, inbox context, and test scaffolding. The next implementation must not rebuild these pieces. It must close only the partial or missing rows in the gap matrix.

allowed: perform local CRM update only inside an approved packet
save local reply draft where supported

contacts_index.purpose: High-density CRM list for One Time leads, members, family/school prospects, and contact records.

toolbar.clear_filters: text button visible only when filters are active

contacts_index.pagination: Server-side cursor pagination with 50 contacts per page. Do not load all contacts or all timelines on initial route load.
contacts_index.open_behavior: Clicking any contact row or contact name must open a dedicated full contact workspace. It must not inject an unexplained detail card into the list.
contacts_index.mobile: Below 900px, replace the table with 76px contact cards and show one pane at a time.

contact_workspace.purpose: Selected contact workspace with profile, activity, local timeline, linked records, class/trial/access context, and safe next actions.
contact_workspace.route_state: Route state must contain a stable canonical contact key using the existing Operations route framework.

header.disabled_tooltip_rule: Email and WhatsApp show one concise disabled tooltip when provider readiness or consent is missing. Do not display large internal no-send explanations.

responsive.mobile_899_and_below: Display one full-width pane at a time.

contact_workspace.write_policy: CRM-local updates are allowed only after the packet explicitly enables a scoped local-write UI, action registry row, audit evidence, isolated test DB persistence proof, and no-send flags. External sends remain separate.

scoped_inbox.purpose: One Time email/inbox workspace that can retain selected CRM context and show draft/readiness gates.

desktop_1280_and_above.gutter_rule: 1px borders rather than floating card gaps

conversation.status_rule: Show queued/sent/failed status. Do not label a queued message as sent.

responsive.tablet_1024_1279: Contact inspector opens as a 400px drawer.
responsive.mobile_below_900: Show thread list or conversation, never squeezed side-by-side; use a 44px Back control; retain selected contact and thread in URL/session state.

scoped_inbox.round_trip_rule: Opening a thread from the contact record must retain the contact. Returning from Inbox must reopen the same contact and tab.
scoped_inbox.send_policy: Draft creation is local preview. Live email send requires exact natural-language or configured approval for the prepared recipient/copy/sender plus the endpoint confirmation gate; bulk sends require a separate campaign packet.

tasks_and_pipeline.task_creation_rule: Task creation belongs in the Tasks tab and Schedule Follow-up action. Do not scatter duplicate task forms across the page.
tasks_and_pipeline.pipeline_rule: Pipeline is implemented only after canonical lifecycle mutations and persistence pass. Pipeline columns must come from the canonical lifecycle registry, not a second Kanban-only stage field.

workspace_isolation.server_scope_rule: Every server query must scope by workspace/project before returning data.
required_negative_proof: Create colliding BNA and One Time fixtures with similar names/emails in the isolated test database.
One Time role receives only One Time records.
Rabbi role cannot request a BNA contact by changing an ID or query parameter.
View as Rabbi uses the same shell but rejects mutations server-side.
Super Admin sees multiple workspaces only after explicit workspace selection.
No BNA source labels, BNA parent lead descriptions, internal infrastructure, keys, diagnostics, or command-agent panels appear in normal Rabbi mode.

requirements: defer CRM code until CRM is selected
remove sequential loading of unrelated datasets
use the narrow list DTO for the index
fetch full detail only after selection
cache identical list queries for 30 seconds
paginate rather than render all 503 contacts
remove duplicate overview metrics, API workbench panels, legacy review blocks, and empty command-bot panels from normal Rabbi CRM
no full Operations rerender after a field mutation

canonical_route_browser_journey: Log in as One Time owner.
Land in the canonical scoped Operations shell served through /operations, operations-bootstrap.html, and generated assets.
Reload after each mutation and prove persistence.
Verify a BNA-only fixture is absent.
Verify View as Rabbi rejects writes.

provider_mailbox.purpose: Rabbi-facing provider mailbox for scoped One Time email threads.
provider_mailbox.visibility_policy: Provider session can see only rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class mailbox rows.

canonical_contact_dto.goal: One server-side canonical contact DTO reconciles authorized One Time records from existing sources without creating duplicate person records. Browser code must not join unrelated datasets.

canonical_endpoints.policy: Must enqueue through the existing guarded outbox. It must never call providers directly from browser code.

mutation_contract: roll back optimistic UI on failure
required_mutations: open linked WhatsApp thread when configured and consented

crm_contact_card.privacy: Do not expose raw private notes, raw provider payloads, secrets, contact exports, unrelated BNA school-only data, or records outside the selected workspace/project.

timeline_item.write_policy: Timeline reads are no-send. Local notes or events must be created only through scoped local CRM update APIs with audit metadata.

inbox_thread.workspace_filter: project_id = one_time_mishnah_class or metadata.project_key = one_time_mishnah_class, and workspace_id/workspace_key matches rabbi_sheller_provider

required_evidence: isolated test DB persistence after reload
action registry update if UI is exposed
bulk sends stay blocked without campaign packet
